newsitem.title: USA: Jacor plans 5.3 mln share offers.
newsitem.headline: Jacor plans 5.3 mln share offers.

text.p: Jacor Communications Inc said it would offer about 5.3 million shares of its common stock in two offerings.
The offerings would be made in May 1997 under Jacor's shelf registration statement declared effective by the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission in April 1997, it said.
About 4.6 million of the shares would be offered to the public with Donaldson, Lufkin & Jenrette Securities Corp as the lead underwriter, Jacor said.

In a separate concurrent offering, the company said Equity Group Investments, an affiliate of its largest shareholder the Zell/Chilmark Fund LP, has committed to buy at least $20 million of Jacor's common shares.
Equity Group is a privately-owned investment company headed by Jacor Chairman Samuel Zell, it said.
